messages:
maria.cs: Heads up — client ACME sent 20 promo codes that all return 400 promo_not_active when used. They set campaign start=2025-03-17T00:00:00-07:00 and end=2025-03-17T23:59:59-07:00 via API.
adrian-support: Thanks, can you paste the campaign_id and a sample curl request they used?
maria.cs: campaign_id: camp_0a9f3b. Sample payload they posted:
```json
{
  "code": "ACME-Spring",
  "start_at": "2025-03-17T00:00:00-07:00",
  "end_at": "2025-03-17T23:59:59-07:00",
  "redemption_limit": 100,
  "per_customer_limit": 1
}
```
customer-bot: Incoming support email thread attached (customer says codes "never activate" on launch day).
adrian-support: OK. Did they create via UI or API? Any timezone picker selected?
maria.cs: API.
eli-platform: I pulled camp_0a9f3b from the DB — stored start_at = 2025-03-17T07:00:00Z, end_at = 2025-03-18T06:59:59Z. That looks like correct UTC-normalization for -07:00 offset.
anne-product: Hmm so why would redemption return promo_not_active? That response happens when now < start OR now > end OR status=ended.
josh-engineering: I just checked logs for campaign lifecycle events. We have an edge case: when campaigns are created via API with identical local-day start and end (midnight->23:59:59), our validation path does a compare using naive local Date objects in one branch and UTC in another. In this case we hit a code path that converted both dates to UTC then compared incorrectly and flagged the campaign as already ended because a timezone conversion + microsecond rounding made start > end.
maria.cs: So campaign got created but in status=ended immediately?
josh-engineering: Yes. DB has ended=true and end_at < start_at after our normalization bug. That triggers promo_not_active for redemptions.
adrian-support: Are customers already charged or affected beyond inability to redeem?
maria.cs: They couldn't redeem; some reported credits were not granted. We offered manual grants to a few key users.
anne-product: Can we do a quick mitigation for ACME while patch goes out?
josh-engineering: Short-term fixes:
- Manual fix: update DB for camp_0a9f3b to set ended=false and set start_at to 2025-03-17T07:00:00Z and end_at to 2025-03-18T06:59:59Z (makes window correct in UTC). I can run a safe script.
- Rollback validation branch that flips ended flag on create. But better: fix parsing function.

Repro steps I used locally:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/campaigns -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d @payload.json (payload as above)
2) curl https://api.redwood.example/v1/campaigns/camp_0a9f3b returns {"status":"ended","start_at":"2025-03-17T07:00:00Z","end_at":"2025-03-18T06:59:59Z"}
3) attempt redemption -> 400 {"code":"promo_not_active","message":"campaign is not active"}

josh-engineering: I pushed a fix to parseRfc3339() so we consistently use UTC for comparisons: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/5829 — tests added for DST/offset edgecases.
deploy-bot: deploy queued — staging rollout started for commit 9f3b2a (patch/redemption-timezone-fix).
eli-platform: I ran the manual DB patch in a transaction for camp_0a9f3b and set ended=false. I also extended end_at by +1 day to be safe. Verified redemptions now succeed for a test user.
adrian-support: Great. Did we grant any credits to affected end users as consolation?
maria.cs: We granted 50 free-trial credits to the 6 customers who reported failures; billing team notified.
anne-product: Need to add an automatic alert for campaigns where end_at < start_at on creation to catch regressions. Filing ticket PROD-1124.
josh-engineering: Agree, will add a create-time check and non-blocking alert. Also running a migration to scan recent campaigns for invalid windows.
adrian-support: Messaging for customers: "We're sorry — we discovered a timezone parsing bug that caused some campaigns to be marked ended immediately. We've fixed it and manually reopened affected campaigns. If you tried to redeem a code between 2025-03-17 00:00 PST and 2025-03-17 08:00 PST please reply and we'll issue credits."
maria.cs: I sent that message to ACME and they confirmed redemptions working now :thumbsup:.
deploy-bot: Staging -> canary -> prod deploy completed for patch 9f3b2a. No rollback required.
josh-engineering: Follow-ups — add unit tests, add e2e for API-created campaign timezone, and add a dashboard metric for creation-time validation failures.
anne-product: Thanks all. Closing loop once PROD-1124 and migration done.
adrian-support: Closing ticket with customer. Good job team :tada:
